campaigns.list.title: Search Campaigns
campaigns.list.description: Search campaigns in a LinkedIn ad account. Live calls use the versioned adCampaigns finder; a response-only input still normalizes an already fetched payload.

ids.description: Campaign IDs for a batch get.

response.description: Already fetched provider payload for the sync normalizer.

ad_accounts.list.title: Search Ad Accounts
ad_accounts.list.description: Search LinkedIn ad accounts by status, type, name, reference, id, or test flag.

response.description: Already fetched provider payload for the sync normalizer.

creative_assets.list.title: List Creative Assets
creative_assets.list.description: List creative assets for an ad account with the versioned creatives criteria finder.

response.description: Already fetched provider payload for the sync normalizer.

campaigns.get.title: Get Campaign
campaigns.get.description: Fetch a single LinkedIn Ads campaign by account and campaign ID (numeric or URN).

ad_accounts.get.title: Get Ad Account
ad_accounts.get.description: Fetch a single LinkedIn Ads ad account by ID (numeric or URN).

campaign_groups.list.title: List Campaign Groups
campaign_groups.list.description: List campaign groups for an ad account (q=search) with cursor paging via pageSize/pageToken.

start.description: Deprecated: index paging was replaced by cursor paging in 202401. Only 0 (or omitted) is accepted; use pageToken.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. ACTIVE. Sent as search=(status:(values:List(...))).

creatives.list.title: List Creatives
creatives.list.description: List creatives for an ad account via the creatives finder (distinct from creative_assets.list).

start.description: Deprecated: index paging was replaced by cursor paging in 202401. Only 0 (or omitted) is accepted; use pageToken.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID/URN to filter creatives.

analytics.report.get.title: Get Analytics Report
analytics.report.get.description: Fetch aggregated LinkedIn Ads analytics via /rest/adAnalytics. q is analytics or statistics. Requires pivot, a start date (dateRangeStart, startDate, or dateRange.start), and at least one of accounts, campaigns, campaignGroups, or creatives.

campaignGroups.description: Sponsored campaign group IDs or URNs.

pivot.description: Analytics pivot, e.g. ACCOUNT, CAMPAIGN, CREATIVE.

timeGranularity.description: ALL, DAILY, MONTHLY, or YEARLY (default ALL).

dateRangeStart.description: Inclusive start date as YYYY-MM-DD or {year,month,day}.

dateRangeEnd.description: Optional inclusive end date as YYYY-MM-DD or {year,month,day}.

fields.description: Metric projection. An array or a comma-separated string. Maximum 20 metrics; dateRange and pivotValues are always added. Defaults to dateRange,pivotValues,impressions,clicks,costInLocalCurrency,costInUsd,landingPageClicks,externalWebsiteConversions,totalEngagements,oneClickLeads,videoViews.

dateRange.description: Composio date range with start and optional end of {year,month,day}.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the LinkedIn Ads connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

campaign_groups.get.title: Get Campaign Group
campaign_groups.get.description: Fetch a campaign group by account and campaign group ID.

audience_counts.get.title: Get Audience Counts
audience_counts.get.description: Estimate audience size for a LinkedIn targetingCriteriaV2 Rest.li expression. Requires the LinkedIn Marketing API program.

targetingCriteria.description: Rest.li targeting expression, for example (include:(and:List(...))). The runner encodes it as one query value.

targeting.facets.list.title: Get Targeting Facets
targeting.facets.list.description: List available LinkedIn Ads targeting facets.

targeting.entities.list.title: Get Targeting Entities
targeting.entities.list.description: Find LinkedIn targeting entities by facet, typeahead, URN list, or similar entities.

entityUrns.description: Entity URNs used as the seed set for similarity search.

q.description: Finder. Defaults to similarEntities when entityUrns is set.

supply_forecasts.get.title: Get Ad Supply Forecasts
supply_forecasts.get.description: Estimate LinkedIn ad supply for a time range, targeting criteria, and optional bid, budget, and objective fields.

account.description: Sponsored account URN or ID. Alias of accountId.

timeRange.description: {start,end} millisecond timestamps. Alias of startTime and endTime.

lead_forms.list.title: List Lead Forms
lead_forms.list.description: List lead forms by sponsored account, organization, or a batch of form IDs.

lead_forms.get.title: Get Lead Form
lead_forms.get.description: Fetch a LinkedIn lead form by its ID. Requires LinkedIn Lead Sync program access.

ad_accounts.create.title: Create Ad Account
ad_accounts.create.description: Create a LinkedIn Ads BUSINESS ad account for an organization or person. ENTERPRISE is reserved for LinkedIn internal use. Requires rw_ads.

type.description: Must be BUSINESS when creating accounts through the API.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Defaults to USD.

test.description: Create a non-serving test account. Immutable after creation.

lead_forms.create.title: Create Lead Form
lead_forms.create.description: Create a LinkedIn lead generation form owned by a sponsored account or organization. Requires LinkedIn Lead Sync / rw_ads access.

owner.description: Union of sponsoredAccount or organization URNs.

content.description: Form content including questions, headline, and legal info.

organizations.network_size.get.title: Get organization follower count
organizations.network_size.get.description: Retrieve first-degree follower count for a LinkedIn organization via /rest/networkSizes.

organizations.acls.list.title: Get organization access control list
organizations.acls.list.description: List organization ACLs by organization URN or by the authenticated member (roleAssignee).

organizations.page_statistics.get.title: Get organization page statistics
organizations.page_statistics.get.description: Retrieve lifetime or time-bound page view and click statistics for an organization the member administers.

organizations.follower_statistics.get.title: Get organization follower statistics
organizations.follower_statistics.get.description: Retrieve follower demographics or time-bound follower growth for an organization.

organizations.share_statistics.get.title: Get organization share statistics
organizations.share_statistics.get.description: Retrieve organic share engagement statistics for an organization, optionally filtered to share or ugcPost URNs.

conversion_rules.list.title: List Conversion Rules
conversion_rules.list.description: List conversion tracking rules for a sponsored ad account.

dmp_segments.list.title: List DMP Segments
dmp_segments.list.description: List DMP audience segments by ad account or by segment IDs.

organizations.list.title: List Organizations
organizations.list.description: Find LinkedIn organizations by vanity name, parent organization, or batch IDs.

posts.list.title: List LinkedIn posts
posts.list.description: List posts by author or sponsored ad account, or batch-get posts by share/ugcPost URNs.

organizations.lookup.title: Lookup organizations
organizations.lookup.description: Batch-lookup organization profiles by numeric IDs without requiring admin access.

uploads.register.title: Register Upload
uploads.register.description: Register a LinkedIn media asset upload (image or video) and return the upload URL. Does not PUT binary bytes.

events.search.title: Search Events
events.search.description: Search LinkedIn events by organizer, optionally filtered to lead-gen-enabled events.

lead_forms.update.title: Update lead form
lead_forms.update.description: Partially update a LinkedIn lead form via Rest.li PARTIAL_UPDATE. Published forms only accept a subset of fields.

organizations.acls.update.title: Update organization access control
organizations.acls.update.description: Request an organization ACL role for the authenticated member. External apps can only request DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER in REQUESTED state.

roleAssignee.description: Person URN of the member receiving the role.
